question: Does the C2 result (joint_LMCoxa / joint_RMCoxa resist an imposed forward displacement under H1 and H1_FLIP reverses it) reproduce on never-run CNS seeds 4, 5 and 6?
policy: Part A C3: separately preregistered; only the two candidates enabled; new seeds. CONFIRMED -> CONDITIONAL (COXA_CONDITIONAL_H1, counted separately); PARTIAL -> stays 'C2 passed'; NOT_CONFIRMED -> NOT_SUPPORTED.

sources.c2_p0_raw_note: local, uncommitted C2 raw arms; hashes from the C2 report

context.displacement: SHIFT_SERVO_EQUILIBRIUM at state 5005; biasprm[aid,0] += kp*Delta on the joint_LMCoxa / joint_RMCoxa baseline position servos
context.seed_mechanism: brain.rng = default_rng(seed) at attach, before the first neural transition

arms.REPRO_1: C2 arm P0_1 rerun by this module (seed 1, displacement, no hypothesis channel)
arms.P0: Step C A_ON + displacement; no hypothesis channel
arms.PF: P0 + H1_FLIP of the same two channels

integrity.I2_common_rng_within_seed: identical per-tick uniforms and schedule within each new seed
integrity.I3_reproduction: REPRO_1 equals C2 P0_1 in every sample's qpos and commanded_joints, every tick's fired, uniforms_sha256 and hair_delivered, and the event after_sha256
integrity.I4_displacement_verified: event at 5005, SHIFT_SERVO_EQUILIBRIUM, after sha == expected sha, declared Delta values, one expected sha across all 10 arms
integrity.I5_channels_bounds: v3 inventories identical; P0 and REPRO no hypothesis channel and constant LM/RM Coxa commands; PC/PF exactly the two channels with the declared hashes; |offset| <= 0.25 rad; other non-v3 commands equal P0
integrity.I6_prefix_within_seed: PC/PF equal P0 until their first coxa command
integrity.I7_seeds_applied: tick-1 uniforms of seeds 4, 5, 6 differ from each other and from C2 P0_1..3; every arm records its seed

context_precondition: every P0_s (s = 4..6) has mean window hair-plate rate >= 30 Hz in both LM and RM; else INCONCLUSIVE_CONTEXT with no labels

measures.df: mean coxa forward component in the window: arm minus P0_s, per middle leg

reported_not_labelled.pre_displacement_offsets: per PC/PF arm, mean channel offset over samples 1-5005 and over the window
reported_not_labelled.pre_displacement_df: mean forward component over 400-500 ms: PC/PF minus P0_s, per middle leg

labels.seed_pass: df(PC_s) <= -0.02 and df(PF_s) >= +0.02 for that leg

flags.BOUND_LIMITED: offset within 0.01 rad of 0.25 in more than half of window samples in any PC/PF arm
flags.ROLLOVER: any sample with tilt > 90 deg in any arm
flags.NO_DRIVE: the PC command of the coordinate never changes in any new seed (reported as input-limited)

consequence_declared_in_advance: CONFIRMED coordinates become CONDITIONAL with evidence C1 (D2 H1), C2 (PR #316), C3 (this test), C4 (integrity); if both, 20/42 admitted +4 conditional (counted separately). PARTIAL/NOT_CONFIRMED recorded as above, nothing retried. No weights, thresholds, gains, mappings or Delta change; balance and gait not established.
interpretation_limits: Engineering perturbation imposed through the servo equilibrium; a probe stimulus, not a biological input.
Seeds vary only stochastic sensory timing.
CONDITIONAL is not admission; a later preregistered failure revokes it.
